t.E942.agn: In 1985 JECFA found nitrous oxide acceptable as a propellant; in its last evaluation in 2000 it listed its functions as propellant, antioxidant and foaming agent. The call for data that EFSA opened in 2023 for gaseous additives also covers this substance; as of July 2026 it is on EFSA's re-evaluation work list.
t.E942.found.0: In the EU, may be used in many foods at quantum satis (as much as needed)
t.E942.prod: Produced chemically by the controlled thermal decomposition of ammonium nitrate.
t.E942.regx.0: Acceptable as a propellant (1985); last evaluated in 2000.
t.E942.regx.1: Group I additive; generally authorised at quantum satis (as much as needed).
t.E942.regx.2: Re-evaluation ongoing (2023 call for data; on the July 2026 FAF working list).
t.E942.summary: Nitrous oxide (laughing gas). Used as a propellant in whipped cream sprays.
t.E942.what: A gas used as a propellant and foaming agent.
